title: Betrayal at House on the Hill
description: A 3-6 player horror exploration board game. This foundation skeleton locks the runtime board layout, asset paths, and the entry point for later gameplay work.

scenario.title: First Scenario
scenario.objective: Explore before the haunt; after it begins, defeat the traitor, place two exorcism circles, and banish Jack's Spirit.
scenario.heroGoal: Investigate Jack and study two exorcism circles; if needed, knock down the traitor first, then exorcise once Jack's Spirit appears.
scenario.traitorGoal: Stop the heroes from completing the circles and exorcism. Chase and attack them; the traitor wins if every hero falls.
scenario.monsterGoal: After the traitor is knocked down, Jack's Spirit appears as a monster. The traitor controls it, moves it, attacks heroes, and tries to return to the corpse room to revive.

basicSetup.title: Core Turn: Use, Move, Explore
basicSetup.description: Start from the pre-haunt board, then use a possession, move, explore, and resolve a discovery check.

steps.setupRuntime: The haunt has not started yet. Walk through a core turn: read the board, use a possession, move, explore an unknown room, and resolve the discovery.
steps.objectiveAndTurn: Your goal is to keep exploring the house. The bottom actions are the main entry points: Move, Explore, Trade, Use, and End Turn.
steps.traitsAndSpeed: Read Speed before moving. Speed tells you the farthest you can move this turn.
steps.movesRemaining: The movement medallion in the upper-right shows how many steps remain right now. It decreases as you move, so it may not equal your full Speed.
steps.roomBoard: The central room board is the main play area. Check where you are, which rooms connect, and where exploration can continue.
steps.inventoryAndHelp: The lower-left area is your inventory. Items and omens stay here; later use, trade, and effect choices start from these cards.
steps.useBook: Select the Book in your inventory, then click Use. The Book points the next non-combat check toward Knowledge.
steps.openMoveTargets: Now choose Move. Glowing rooms are places you can still reach this turn.
steps.moveToHallway: Move into the Hallway. It connects to a new exit, so the next step can reveal an unknown room.
steps.exploreUpper: Select the explorable face-down room. It reveals as a new room, then immediately draws the matching discovery card.
steps.finish: The discovery has entered a Knowledge check. After the dice stop, you may use Rabbit's Foot to reroll one die; continue only when you do not want to change the result.

hauntActions.title: After the Haunt: Read the Goal, Then Exorcise
hauntActions.description: After the haunt begins, see why the goal changed before finishing the hero exorcism check.

steps.setupReadyToExorcise: Exploration and omens can push the house into the haunt. This is now Crimson Jack Returns: the heroes must banish Jack's Spirit, and the traitor must stop them.
steps.helpEntry: The goal has changed after the haunt: heroes are no longer just exploring. Open the haunt reference to see how each side wins.
steps.hauntActions: The exorcism is not appearing out of nowhere. The heroes have already investigated Jack and studied two exorcism circles, so the last step is exorcising him.
steps.exorciseJack: Use Exorcise now to make a Sanity check. Once the dice settle, compare the total with the haunt requirement.
steps.endgameReview: The exorcism succeeds. Jack's Spirit is banished, and the survivors escape.

heroAttackPath.title: Hero Attacks the Traitor
heroAttackPath.description: After opening the haunt reference, show how a hero uses the real attack entry to pressure the traitor.

steps.setupHeroAttack: Now look at the hero attack branch. The hero has investigated Jack; when the traitor is in the same room, the hero can attack to help release Jack's Spirit.
steps.heroAttackObjective: Open the haunt reference first. Heroes do more than exorcise: before the final exorcism, a hero may need to attack the traitor to advance the scenario.
steps.attackTraitor: Choose Attack Traitor. Both sides roll dice; because the hero investigated Jack, this attack gains an extra bonus.
steps.heroAttackReview: The hero attack has resolved. This view shows the attack dice, the bonus, and the result instead of only describing the rule.

jackSpiritPath.title: Jack's Spirit Acts
jackSpiritPath.description: After the traitor falls, show Jack's Spirit continuing as a monster that moves and attacks heroes.

steps.setupJackSpirit: After the traitor is knocked down, Jack's Spirit has appeared and becomes the active threat. It is not background text; it is a monster that keeps acting.
steps.jackSpiritObjective: Open the haunt reference first. Jack's Spirit attacks heroes and tries to return to the corpse room so the traitor can revive.
steps.jackSpiritAttack: Choose a hero in the same room for the monster attack. Jack's Spirit uses the same real attack roll flow.
steps.jackSpiritReview: Jack's Spirit attack has resolved. The same attack dice table shows the dice, total, and outcome.

traitorPath.title: If the Traitor Succeeds
traitorPath.description: Switch to the traitor side and see the alternate ending.

steps.setupTraitorTurn: Now switch to the traitor side. This is not the next step after the hero victory; it demonstrates what happens if the traitor's chase succeeds.
steps.traitorObjective: The traitor does not study circles. The traitor closes in, attacks, and tries to knock down every hero.
steps.attackHero: Choose a hero in the same room for the enemy attack. The attack rolls both sides, and the difference becomes damage.
steps.traitorFinish: When every hero falls, Crimson Jack prevails and the traitor wins.
